title: 南京大学软件学院2026年度准聘长聘岗位（事业编制）招聘公告
content: 南京大学软件学院2026年度准聘长聘岗位（事业编制）招聘公告 专任教师 首页 > 专任教师 > 专任教师岗位列表 点击申请 学院介绍 招聘岗位设置 申请条件 申请材料 薪酬待遇和相关工作与生活条件配套 申请截止日期 联系方式 Apply Now About the School Positions Qualifications Supporting Materials for Application Compensation Package and Support Application deadline contacts 收起 南京大学软件学院2026年度准聘长聘岗位（事业编制）招聘公告 Tenure-Track/Tenured Faculty Positions in Software Institute,Nanjing University,2026 发布时间：2026-06-11 浏览次数： English Introduction Switching： 中 / En 打开微信，点击底部的“发现”， 使用“扫一扫”即可将网页分享至朋友圈。 学院介绍 南京大学软件学院是教育部首批国家级示范性软件学院，2021年入选国家首批特色化示范性软件学院（关键基础软件、行业应用软件），依托软件工程一级学科和计算机软件新技术全国重点实验室，建有“江苏省实验教学中心——软件工程实验教学中心”和“国家级实验教学中心——计算机科学与软件工程实验教学中心”（与计算机学院共建）等教学平台，先后三次荣获国家教学成果二等奖，在历次学科评估中均名列前茅。学院拥有一支高素质的师资队伍，现有教授12人，副教授8人，准聘副教授6人，其中国家级领军人才2人、国家级青年人才4人等。 招聘岗位设置 南京大学软件学院拟面向全球招聘有志于从事软件工程领域各主要研究方向的优秀青年人才到学院工作。本次拟招聘准聘助理教授岗位、准聘副教授岗位总数不超过10个，其中准聘副教授岗位不超过3个，特别优秀的高层次人才岗位另议。 招聘研究方向包括： 1.泛在操作系统理论及其架构 2.智能软件可信保障与安全治理 3.工业软件核心技术 4.软件工程 5.计算机科学与技术 应聘条件 1.遵守中华人民共和国法律和法规，热爱教学科研事业； 2.具有良好的师德师风，恪守学术道德，勤勉工作，无犯罪记录，无违反师德师风和学术道德惩处记录； 3.一流的学术背景：具有相关学科领域的博士学位，具有一流教学科研机构的学习、工作经验，熟悉相关领域国际前沿的研究动态。原则上，准聘助理教授要求博士毕业从事学术研究2年以上，准聘副教授要求博士毕业从事学术研究4年以上； 4.出色的教学能力：应具有能够胜任本专业核心基础课程和前沿课程的教学能力，掌握良好的教学方法，具有较强的语言表达能力； 5.突出的科研成果显示度与未来科研发展潜力：应有相关研究方向的成果显示度，对相关研究领域有原创性观点，未来研究计划思路清晰，具有较好的学术潜力； 6.截至招聘公告发布之日未满40周岁（即指1986年6月11日以后出生），以有效期内的身份证件上的日期为准。如申请人已具有副高及以上职称，年龄可适当放宽； 7.身体健康。 应聘材料 1.三封推荐信（一般来自博士生导师、现工作单位学术负责人、本领域知名学者）； 2.详细个人简历（中英文）； 3.三篇代表作（一般为招聘公告截止前已正式见刊发表或已在线发表并有DOI编号的论文或专著，需上传全文）； 4.其他证明学术成就的相关附件。 以上应聘材料请登录招聘系统后根据要求提交。 薪酬待遇和相关配套 1.事业编制（外籍人员除外）； 2.实行年薪制（具体另行商定）； 3.科研启动经费； 4.研究生招生； 5.学校提供短期周转住房和住房补贴，为人才安居提供支持。 申请截止日期 2026年09月11日 若到期单个岗位申报人数较少则适当延长。 请点击左侧【点击申请】或登录南京大学人才招聘网(http://zp.nju.edu.cn/)注册报名。 政策咨询 联系电话：张老师 025-83621277 电子邮箱：zhanglei@nju.edu.cn 学院网址：https://software.nju.edu.cn/cpyc/index.html ------- About the School The School of Software, Nanjing University, is one of earliest software schools established in China. In 2021, it was selected as one of the first batch of characteristic and exemplary software institutes in China (key basic software and industry application software). It hosts a number of high profile teaching and research centers, like Jiangsu Province Experimental Teaching Center-Software Engineering Experimental Teaching Center and National Experimental Teaching Center-Computer Science and Software Engineering Experimental Teaching Center (co-hosted with the Department of Computer Science). In terms of teaching, the school faculty have won the National Teaching Award three times. In terms of research, it was ranked very high by CSranking. Positions The School of Software, Nanjing University plans to recruit young scholars who aspire to have a career in the field of software engineering . The application is open to scholars from all over the world. There are vacancies for tenure-track assistant professor and tenure-track associate professor (up to 10 vacancies in total, of which up to 3 is for tenure-track associate professors) this year. Higher positions for particularly outstanding scholars are available and application will be considered individually. Specific fields of research open for recruitment are: 1.Theories and architectures of ubiquitous operating systems 2.Trustworthiness assurance and security governance of intelligent software 3.Core technologies for industrial software 4.Software Engineering 5.Computer Science and Technology Qualifications The applicant should 1.abide by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China, and have a passion for teaching and research; 2.abide by the ethics of teachers, uphold academic integrity, be willing to work diligently, and have no criminal record or record in breaching the ethics of teachers and/or academic integrity; 3.have a first-rate background in academic training—specifically, a PhD in relevant disciplines, experience in studying and/or working at first-rate teaching and research institutions, and knowledge of the latest international trends and development in the relevant research field(s); In principle, the applicant for Assistant Professor should have engaged in academic research for more than two years after receiving the doctoral degree. The applicant for Associate Professor should have engaged in academic research for more than four years after receiving the doctoral degree. 4.have outstanding teaching abilities—the applicant should be able to teach core and frontline courses in the corresponding discipline, and have sound teaching methodology and strong verbal skills; 5.demonstrate outstanding research output and potential—the applicant should have publications in his/her field of research, original ideas about relevant fields of research, a clear vision about future research plans, and good potential for further academic development. 6.be in good health. Supporting Materials for Application 1.Three reference letters; 2.A detailed CV (in either Chinese or English); 3.Three representative papers (The representative works submitted for review are generally papers or monographs that have been officially published in journals or have been published online and have DOI numbers); 4.Other relevant attachments that demonstrate academic achievement. Please login to the talent recruitment platform of Nanjing University (http://zp.nju.edu.cn/) to submit the application materials required. Compensation Package and Support 1.An annual salary (to be worked out individually); 2.A start-up fund for research; 3.Qualification to supervise graduate students; 4.The university provides short-term lodging and housing subsidies. Application deadline 2026年09月11日 If the number of applicants for a single post is small, it will be extended appropriately. You could click the "Apply Now" button or login to the talent recruitment platform of Nanjing University (http://zp.nju.edu.cn/) to submit the application materials required.
